explanation: I searched Mathlib for positivity-improving operators and for Jentzsch and Perron-Frobenius results. The only hits were matrix irreducibility (Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Matrix/Irreducible/Defs.lean) and unrelated files. I found nothing about the constant sign of a top eigenvector of a positivity-improving compact self-adjoint operator on L². The statement relies on the library's own definitions and lemmas (IsPositivityImproving', abs_eigenvector_of_top_eigenvector, ground_state_strictly_positive).
